scope: Source audit, deterministic lifecycle characterization and local diagnostic instrumentation. Recovery changes are a separate step after this audit.
conclusion: Recovery defects are reproduced in service tests. The initiating cause of the October 17 field failure is not established without device timelines. STUN-only connectivity is a relevant hypothesis given mobile data use, not a confirmed cause.

architecture.coordination: Firebase Realtime Database /teamRadio/team with real Firebase Auth
architecture.media: Direct WebRTC pairs involving at least one speaker; no listener-to-listener links
architecture.limits: 10 participant places, 3 speaking places, at most 24 bidirectional pairs room-wide
architecture.negotiation: Lower numeric seat creates the offer; higher seat answers. Session IDs and offerId guard signals. Each directed mailbox retains one latest SDP record.
architecture.ice: One public Google STUN endpoint, no TURN relay, no trickle ICE. SDP is published after gathering completes or a 5-second wait.
architecture.backend: No Team Radio Cloud Functions handlers found. Rules constrain fixed slots, ownership, session signaling and transmission leases. No schema or authorization changes made.

confirmed_findings.finding: Ordinary roster changes preserve unaffected peer connections
confirmed_findings.evidence: Characterization test adds and removes another peer while asserting the original connected peer object and transport remain unchanged.
confirmed_findings.implication: A global teardown on every join is not supported by current implementation or this test. Aggregate presence.ready can still make participants display Connecting when any of their links is not ready.

confirmed_findings.finding: Peer recreation has no retry budget or backoff
confirmed_findings.evidence: Force failed state, run reconciliation and repeat 20 times: 20 transports are created and closed with unchanged participant/session identities.
timeline: A connection-state callback observes failed and removes that peer.
The next room synchronization recreates it because the participant is still present.
Synchronization runs every 250 ms and on database events; no attempt count or delay guards creation.
A further failure repeats the same path.
confirmed_findings.limit_of_evidence: Failures are injected; this does not measure actual ICE failure duration or assert four real negotiation failures per second.

confirmed_findings.finding: One-sided answering-peer recovery reuses an already consumed offer
confirmed_findings.evidence: The same mailbox offer is suppressed by one peer object, then consumed again after that peer is failed and recreated. A separate test proves a stable initiating peer ignores a replacement answer for its old offer.
confirmed_findings.implication: Rebuilding only the answering side does not establish a coordinated new negotiation. This can obstruct recovery even if the network becomes usable.
confirmed_findings.limit_of_evidence: Service tests use synthetic SDP and browser stubs; no real RTP outage or NAT traversal is reproduced.

unconfirmed_hypotheses: Mobile NAT or firewall behavior requires TURN and prevents a direct media path.
Firebase connectivity loss or a heartbeat older than 20 seconds triggers whole-local-session pause and session rotation.
The 5-second ICE gathering deadline omits late candidates; no later candidate updates are sent.
Aggregate readiness changes are perceived as reconnections despite retained healthy transports.

diagnostics_added.storage: At most 200 in-memory events per scoped radio service, oldest evicted. No upload or database writes.
diagnostics_added.console: Opt-in via sessionStorage perrinn.teamRadio.diagnostics=1 before service creation. At most 200 console events per service instance; reload for a fresh capture.
diagnostics_added.events: UTC timestamp, auth state without UID, database connectivity/listener failure, roster seat keys, session join/pause/restore/stop, peer creation/removal/error, ICE/gathering/signaling/connection states, remote track arrival and signal type/offer identity.
diagnostics_added.identifiers: Fixed room seat and opaque local/remote session and offer IDs correlate events; no account IDs or profile names.
diagnostics_added.excluded: No SDP, ICE candidate contents/IP addresses, audio, credentials or full error messages. No background telemetry upload.
diagnostics_added.lifetime: Connection event handlers are removed on peer disposal; diagnostics die with the scoped service. Browser console retention is controlled by the browser.

work_and_cost.diagnostic_work: Constant memory cap of 200 events, state-transition/event logging only; no per-tick or heartbeat logging.
work_and_cost.existing_work: Up to 12 forced presence transaction invocations per joined client per minute, plus readiness transitions. SDK transaction retries and listener traffic are additional. Collection listeners have fixed slot limits; network and total retry work are not thereby bounded for a session.
work_and_cost.media: A speaker can send nine copies of audio. TURN infrastructure and bandwidth costs are unknown and require a separate proposal.

validation.radio_tests: 48 pass, including four lifecycle characterization tests and two diagnostic bounds/opt-in tests
validation.production_build: Pass; existing unused environment.dev.ts compilation warning
validation.lint: Pass, zero errors and 50 warnings in files outside this change
validation.browser_and_device_gap: No new two-device/mobile-network test, real ICE candidate pair, RTP measurement or extended session established in this audit.
validation.rules: Read but unchanged; emulator suite not rerun because schema/authorization are unchanged.
validation.ui: No templates, layouts or controls changed; desktop/mobile visual checks not performed for this instrumentation-only change.

next_steps: Collect simultaneous diagnostic timelines on two distinct accounts with the page visible. Start with the reported mobile-data setup, then compare Wi-Fi. Limit each initial capture to 2 minutes or the first 200 console events per instance; stop once failure is captured.

Distinguish database connection/session rotation from media ICE failure. Use browser WebRTC diagnostics locally to inspect the selected pair and RTP when available; avoid sharing raw SDP/IP dumps publicly.

Design a coordinated fresh-negotiation recovery with a proposed cap of three automatic retries per peer/session episode, delayed 1, 3 and 8 seconds; stop after exhaustion and require explicit retry. Cancel pending work on departure, replacement, sign-out or scope disposal. Preserve unrelated peer transports.
Keep successful reconnects from immediately renewing an unlimited retry budget; define a sustained healthy interval or explicit user reset in the implementation proposal.
If field evidence shows relay-required connectivity, propose managed TURN and short-lived credentials separately, including operating cost and specific backend/security changes for approval.

After the agreed recovery change, validate a 15-minute two-device session, three intentional disconnect/rejoin cycles and three brief network interruptions. Then validate joins/leaves with a third participant before a separate 10-person load test.
issue_status: Open; field diagnosis and separately agreed recovery implementation remain.
